_schema: Combo field x finisher interaction table. 9 fields x 4 finishers = 36 outcomes.
_why: The rotation simulator carries 'Combo fields tracked but not simulated for damage', so every field/finisher chain scores as zero today. Published expert builds treat these as load-bearing ('a water field which you can blast and leap finisher in for extra sustain'), which means the objective cannot currently see a mechanic real builds are designed around.

max_combatants_per_field.note: Only 5 unique combatants may combo with a given field.

finisher_scales_with_finisher_user.note: Combo output uses the stats of the player who applied the FINISHER, not the field. A water blast heals more from higher Healing Power, so combo value couples to gear.

field_priority.note: A finisher prioritises fields you created, then the field created first.

leap_first_field_wins.note: The first field a leap passes through decides the effect. An interrupted leap produces NO finisher.

projectile_partial_proc.note: Some projectile finishers proc at 20% per projectile, usually slot-1 autoattacks and multi-projectile skills. Revenant Hammer autoattack is a documented 100% exception, so this is a per-skill flag and NOT a blanket rate.

ordering.note: Fields must be laid before finishers land. This is a hard ordering constraint on any rotation that intends to combo.

finisher_availability.note: Not every profession has every finisher type. Leap: absent on Necromancer except Reaper or Sword via Expanded Weapon Proficiency. Projectile: absent on Guardian except Longbow via Dragonhunter/Weaponmaster Training, or Pistol via Expanded Weapon Proficiency. Whirl: absent on Engineer and Necromancer except Scrapper and Reaper, or via Weaponmaster Training on Hammer and Greatsword respectively.

_target_key: self = finisher user only; area_allies = allies in the blast; enemy_hit = the struck enemy; bolts = scattered whirl projectiles, may multi-hit one target at point blank
_evidence_level_key: Factual = stated by the wiki or an in-game tooltip; Inferred = consistent secondary source, not wiki-confirmed
